svg.text: Implementation-ready journey: explicit start, local inference, live metrics, system PiP, and deterministic cleanup.
Permission denied → helpful explanation + system settings
No face / stale points → guidance; metrics unavailable
Camera/model/listener failure → release resources; show retry
PiP not supported or blocked → stay in app; explain limitation
B · DISCOVERY, LOCAL AI & DAILY USE
• In-app search field shows topic suggestions and useful queries; no Google-branded search screen.
• External structured results require an authorized/configured provider; otherwise offer transparent browser handoff.
• No Maps dependency, background location, account, or mandatory network request for core use.
• Optional model downloads verify source, exact version, checksum, size, license, and offline compatibility.
• PiP closes/stops must clean up safely; never promise indefinite camera operation against Android restrictions.
• Only approved, sanitized summaries persist locally; frames and raw landmarks are not persisted or uploaded.
Light only, exact tokens, type scale
Tracker and docs kept in sync
Never confuse a visual mockup, a compile pass, or an installed APK with verified camera-to-landmark behavior.
